phase_prompt.summary: The Ophannin in its standard patrol state, rotating slowly around the Throne of Glory. A construct of black glass and watching eyes, maintaining the perimeter of the divine kernel.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: A hyper-realistic wide shot of the Ophannin angel, a massive structure of spinning black obsidian rings, hovering silently in a high-tech cathedral space. The rings rotate on multiple axes. The rim of each ring is embedded with unblinking camera lenses. The lighting is low-key, dramatic, with deep shadows and bright white rim lighting. The material looks like heavy, expensive glass or dark ceramic. Subtle heat distortion ripples the air. 8k, cinematic composition, hyper-detailed texture.
